findings.desc: Verified cwd-dependent smoke regression: the new closure-audit assertions read docs/requirements/decisions/control-plane-proof-capability-closure-audit.md via join(process.cwd(), CLOSURE_AUDIT_PATH). Standard package execution changes cwd to packages/main, so npm --prefix packages/main run test:proof-admissibility-hardening fails with ENOENT at packages/main/docs/requirements/decisions/control-plane-proof-capability-closure-audit.md. Running node packages/main/dist/tasks/proof-admissibility-hardening-smoke.js from repo root passes, and running node dist/tasks/lifecycle-control-smoke.js from packages/main fails the same way. Anchor the audit path to the repo root/module location or make the smoke resolve both supported cwd modes.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved closure-audit smoke path resolution by walking upward from cwd until docs/requirements/decisions/control-plane-proof-capability-closure-audit.md is found. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build; npm --prefix packages/main run test:proof-admissibility-hardening; cd packages/main && node dist/tasks/lifecycle-control-smoke.js; cd repo root && node packages/main/dist/tasks/lifecycle-control-smoke.js; cd repo root && node packages/main/dist/tasks/proof-admissibility-hardening-smoke.js.

findings.desc: DONE-required stale/freshness smoke still writes synthetic command receipts without commandSpec, so the new CommandSpec evaluator turns the intended metadata-only freshness PASS into command-spec-missing[0]. This leaves stale/mismatch coverage inconsistent with the generated DONE_REQUIRED CommandSpec envelope and currently fails npm --prefix packages/main run test:done-required-freshness-smoke after build.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed done-required-freshness-smoke synthetic receipts to include the DONE_REQUIRED CommandSpec envelope/digest shape. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build, npm --prefix packages/main run test:done-required-freshness-smoke, npm --prefix packages/main run test:done-required-validation-smoke, and npm --prefix packages/main run test:proof-admissibility-hardening.

findings.desc: Verified stale review-assurance overclaim remains in the story summary after the F-002 fix. `lattice summary_get {"storyId":"B-c004"}` reports expectedOutcome that the user should see DONE gates satisfied by fresh validation, delivery, review assurance, and intent-equivalence diagnostics, but `lattice done_closure {"storyId":"B-c004"}` reports canAttemptDone=false with a blocking review-assurance-floor row: missing material code paths 12, local rounds 0/3, stale host verdicts ignored, and next action to re-submit local host verdicts over the current materialHash. This contradicts the requested summary de-overclaim/no stale review-assurance overclaim requirement; the summary should state that validation/delivery are fresh while review-assurance floor remains to be satisfied by fresh quorum/fallback evidence, or omit the DONE-gates-satisfied claim until the DONE oracle passes.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved the summary overclaim by updating expectedOutcome, actualTranscript, outcomeDiff, and pitfalls so review assurance is no longer asserted by summary text before the DONE oracle accepts fresh current-material quorum or approved fallback evidence. Evidence: summary_set auto-commit e56c87b; summary now says final DONE readiness is determined by current Lattice gates and review assurance must be satisfied by fresh quorum or approved fallback.

findings.desc: Quality review concurs with open blocker B-c004:F-003: the summary still overclaims DONE-gate satisfaction after F-002. lattice summary_get reports expectedOutcome that DONE gates are satisfied by fresh validation, delivery, review assurance, and intent-equivalence diagnostics, while lattice done_closure and lifecycle_check --target=DONE report canAttemptDone/localReady false because review-assurance-floor/current review evidence remain missing for current material. This violates the requested absence of stale summary overclaim; summary should say validation, DONE_REQUIRED, and delivery are fresh while review assurance remains pending, or omit the DONE-gates-satisfied claim until the DONE oracle passes.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved by the concurrent summary_set fix at e56c87b9a and verified after the quality finding: lattice summary_get now says review assurance is not asserted by summary text and must be satisfied by fresh quorum or approved fallback evidence; lattice lifecycle_check --storyId=B-c004 --target=DONE --json reports story-summary and user-value-summary PASS while keeping review-assurance-floor separately blocked. The summary overclaim concern no longer holds.

findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/proof-admissibility-hardening-execution-plan.md:145 retires durable ledger streams as local CLI non-goals, but the active Appendix G close checklist at docs/requirements/decisions/proof-admissibility-hardening-execution-plan.md:1513 still requires an evidence ledger write path where producers append ArtifactObservedEvent and evaluators append AdmissibilityEvaluationRow. This leaves an active operator-facing ledger obligation outside retired Appendix C, and packages/main/src/tasks/proof-admissibility-hardening-smoke.ts:121 only excludes Appendix C plus a narrow phrase set, so the regression is not mechanically covered.
